quotes.text: IRC and XMPP joinChat tests call the real prototype method and replace only network sends, conversation storage and the constructor. Verify normalized channel/JID, protocol payload and duplicate behavior. XMPP also verifies the object is an instance of the supplied constructor and excludes the password from logged stanza text. Remove debug console.log from committed tests. These tests establish unit behavior, not successful live server joins.
